payload.title: The event UUID rule is compiled twice with the i flag (EVENT_ID_REGEX in base-event.ts and UUID_REGEX in tenant-scope.ts) although the wire pattern both are built from is lowercase-only, and the owner's own comment calls it case-insensitive, so restoreEventId and tenantScopeOf accept ids that the consumer schema rejects.
evidence: libs/event-contracts/src/tenant-scope.ts:36 (UUID_REGEX = new RegExp(UUID_PATTERN, 'i'), the second compiled copy)
libs/event-contracts/src/schemas/common.schema.ts:36-44 (comment says case-insensitive v1-v5, the pattern is lowercase hex and version-agnostic)
libs/event-contracts/src/schemas/common.schema.ts:92 (wire eventId uses the bare pattern string, which Ajv applies case-sensitively)
libs/event-contracts/src/schemas/tenant-events.schema.ts:108-124 (tenant-erasure event schemas spread BASE_EVENT_PROPERTIES, so eventId and tenantId use the case-sensitive pattern)
platform/libs/event-bus/src/nats/nats-event-bus.ts:1433-1451 (the bus validates subjects that have a compiled schema and dead-letters a malformed event)
libs/event-contracts/src/__tests__/tenant-scope.spec.ts:48-51 (pins that an uppercase tenantId is accepted as a tenant scope)
libs/event-contracts/src/__tests__/base-event.spec.ts:254-265 (malformed-id table has no uppercase case, so the rule is pinned neither way)
payload.rule_violated: One owner per fact: the UUID acceptance rule has a pattern owner (common.schema.ts) but two private compiled copies whose flag disagrees with the wire contract and with the owner's comment.
payload.notes: restoreEventId('44444444-4444-4444-8444-44444444444A') returns the id, and eventTenantScope accepts an uppercase tenantId, but every event schema that spreads BASE_EVENT_PROPERTIES (the tenant-erasure schemas through validateTenantEvent, and the farm, sensor and messaging subjects on the bus, where a failure is dead-lettered as schema-validation-failure) applies the case-sensitive wire pattern to the same fields. The producer-side check and the consumer-side check therefore disagree on the same string. Not reachable today because both ids come from PostgreSQL UUID columns that return lowercase text. Close condition: Export one compiled predicate from schemas/common.schema.ts built from UUID_PATTERN with the decided flag, import it in base-event.ts and tenant-scope.ts, correct the comment at common.schema.ts:36-42, and add a spec that runs an uppercase and a lowercase UUID through the predicate and through the compiled BASE_EVENT_PROPERTIES eventId and tenantId schema and asserts equal verdicts. Plan row: DET detector program (landing batch 5). Verified at origin/main d716541239.
